alt: A paper-cutout scene shows one building split by a seam under a shared roofline with a clock. On the left, a worried person stands at a podium holding a sign that reads MONTHS AWAY, with a huge dark robot-shaped shadow looming on the wall behind them. On the right, a small cheerful robot steps out of an open doorway holding a wallet and a shopping bag.
